"""Profile complete old/current bicubic polytropic consumers after warmup."""
import copy
import cProfile
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pstats
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "benchmark"))
from run import cpu_affinity
cpu_affinity(0xffff)
os.environ.update(JAX_ENABLE_X64="true", JAX_PLATFORM_NAME="cpu", MPLBACKEND="Agg", OMP_NUM_THREADS="1")
import jax
import thermopt as current

reference_root = HERE / "reference"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("thermopt_profile_reference", reference_root / "thermopt/__init__.py", submodule_search_locations=[str(reference_root / "thermopt")])
reference = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = reference
spec.loader.exec_module(reference)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from development.bicubic.validate_060 import configuration
config, _ = configuration("sco2_simple_polytropic", "bicubic", 100, False, HERE, ROOT / "benchmark/results/tables")
problems = {name: package.ThermodynamicCycleProblem(copy.deepcopy(config["problem_formulation"]), out_dir=str(HERE / f"profile_{name}")) for name, package in (("reference", reference), ("current", current))}
for problem in problems.values():
    problem.fitness(problem.x0)
    jax.block_until_ready(problem.cycle_data)
profiles = {name: cProfile.Profile() for name in problems}
for sample in range(20):
    for name in (("reference", "current") if sample % 2 == 0 else ("current", "reference")):
        profiles[name].enable()
        problems[name].fitness(problems[name].x0)
        jax.block_until_ready(problems[name].cycle_data)
        profiles[name].disable()
for name, profile in profiles.items():
    profile.dump_stats(str(HERE / f"{name}.pstats"))
    with (HERE / f"{name}_profile.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        pstats.Stats(profile, stream=stream).strip_dirs().sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(35)
    print(name)
    print((HERE / f"{name}_profile.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
